description: Naveran, Gorka and colleagues publish this resource through the native repository. The completed verification report distinguishes four control developments and their validation settings. Consumption model-predictive control is virtually validated for Basurto and experimentally tested at CSEM headquarters. Generation and distribution controllers and the pump optimizer receive virtual and experimental tests at Basurto. The source reports final/primary energy savings relative to each development and its share of total consumption, without numeric results in the abstract. These different settings must not be collapsed into a claim that all controllers were physically tested at one site. Zenodo publishes the record with open access and a native licence label of cc-by-4.0. Source metadata and file descriptors were inspected; no linked files, model archives, code or documentation bodies were opened. Coverage and validation are limited to the stated model, data or application. Publication date does not establish current software maintenance. The validation supports assessment of district-cooling control and energy performance.
